_about: In-game strings (ui/data/*.json) that may still carry a British spelling, by file and pointer, while a ruling or a swap is pending. Empty since Legal's RL-193 (2026-10-27) ruled American for the eleven that RL-192 did not name, and UI swapped them. tools/check-site-interim.mjs fails on any British spelling in text a player reads that is not listed here, prints a note for an entry that no longer matches (remove it), and fails if this file is missing. Entries look like {"file": "ui/data/howto.json", "pointer": "/pages/5/title", "why": "..."}.
